reconcile.note: Fausset reads Proverbs' peace-with-enemies promise as a general rule that has always carried persecution for godliness as its standing exception.

discrepancy.note: Remsburg's contradiction catalog poses the earthly reward of discipleship as an open question, then answers it with 2 Timothy 3:12's guarantee of persecution.

quotes.text: What is to be the earthly reward of those that follow Christ? … “Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution” ( 2 Tim. iii, 12 ).
quotes.attr: John E. Remsburg (d. 1919), The Christ: A Critical Review and Analysis of the Evidences of His Existence (1909), "Bible Contradictions," on 2 Timothy 3:12.

sides.snippet: When a man's ways please Yahweh, He makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
sides.verseText: When a man's ways please Yahweh, He makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

sides.snippet: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
sides.verseText: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
